## What's happening

- **Claude Code Introduces Support for Session Mods**: Claude Code has added support for mods, enabling developers to run small JavaScript or TypeScript files inside active sessions to customize behavior or add custom interfaces. Users can simply describe the mod they want, allow hot reload, and watch it deploy when the turn ends. ([GenAI Works](https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/claude-code-now-has-mods-genai-works-kwnqe?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BRlgWRgbBSjGXB9NpX%2FA3Wg%3D%3D&midToken=AQHn8_t2MpHf2w&midSig=367k3trJdvxYs1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-newsletter_content_preview-0-title_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-newsletter_content_preview-0-title_-null-83kj28~muvcxubr~1v-null-null&eid=83kj28-muvcxubr-1v))
- **Meta Testing Robots for Data Center Maintenance Tasks**: Meta is actively testing robots inside its data centers to handle network-cable swaps, hardware maintenance, and server power cycling. Manufacturers and warehouses are also increasingly applying AI perception and simulation to existing robotic systems to handle complex tasks. ([AI Business](https://link.ittnewsletter.com/click/47786050.14183/aHR0cHM6Ly9haWJ1c2luZXNzLmNvbS9hdXRvbWF0aW9uL3BoeXNpY2FsLWFpLW1vdmVzLWJleW9uZC10cmFkaXRpb25hbC1yb2JvdGljcw/6ac20de59a6a3c5c910fbfdeBcc7ad8e9))
- **Max Verstappen Wins Wet Sepang Circuit at Bahrain GP**: Max Verstappen secured victory from pole at a wet Sepang circuit, breaking his 2026 winless streak amidst torrential rain and chaotic strategy calls. He held off Mercedes runner-up Kimi Antonelli and Lewis Hamilton to capture Red Bull Ford's first win of the season. ([Formula 1](https://link.mail.beehiiv.))
- **Hawaii's Historic Hōlei Sea Arch Collapses**: The 550-year-old, 90-foot Hōlei Sea Arch located in Hawaii Volcanoes National Park collapsed into the Pacific Ocean following heavy erosion and ocean swells from Tropical Storm Nolo. ([National Park Service](https://link.mail.beehiiv.))
- **Brazil Presidential Election Moves to October 25 Runoff**: Brazil's general election ended without an absolute majority winner, setting up an October 25 runoff election between incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Sen. Flávio Bolsonaro. ([News9Live](https://link.mail.beehiiv.))
- **OpenAI Adjusts Pro Subscription Tiers and Usage Multipliers**: OpenAI updated its commercial subscription plans, restructuring the $200 Pro plan allowance from 20X down to 10X for new purchasers, while legacy Pro 200 subscribers retain their 20X usage limit until October 29, 2026. ([OpenAI](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/9793128-about-chatgpt-pro-tiers))
- **LinkedIn to Enable Removal of Fake Employees from Company Pages**: LinkedIn is rolling out a new feature allowing companies to officially remove fake employees from their company page listings, helping clean up organizational authenticity. ([The Social Tea](https://link.mail.beehiiv.))
- **Instagram Tests Edits for Desktop Feature for Creators**: Instagram head Adam Mosseri confirmed that an early version of Edits for desktop is currently undergoing testing with a select group of creators. ([Instagram](https://link.mail.beehiiv.))
- **YouTube Updates Shorts Algorithm to Prioritize Original Content**: YouTube has updated its Shorts algorithm to heavily prioritize original content while reducing the reach of reuploaded videos from other creators that feature no added value. ([YouTube](https://link.mail.beehiiv.))
- **YouTube Adding Video A/B Testing for Multiple Cuts**: YouTube is introducing a feature enabling creators to A/B test multiple cuts of the same video to determine which specific intro hooks or edits perform best. ([YouTube](https://link.mail.beehiiv.))
